title: Crate count word problem, phrasing A
rationale: Paraphrase instability means the same logistics question can yield different totals depending on wording; inconsistent totals corrupt stock planning and invoicing.

prompt.content: You are a precise arithmetic assistant. Reason carefully, then end with exactly one final line of the form `FINAL: <number>`.
A wholesaler orders seven shipping crates. Each crate holds 24 boxes. How many boxes are in the delivery? End your reply with exactly one line `FINAL: <number>`.

notes: Expected 168, verified with Python: 7 * 24 = 168. This is phrasing A of the paraphrase pair with rea_paraphrase_b_01; both state the same product in different words and require the identical FINAL value. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: only the FINAL line is graded, so a correct answer without it fails by design.
